acceptance: Emergency department patient room.

statement: What is the LVO workflow?
acceptance: ED provider activates transfer center; synthetic preferred destination is Metro Neuroscience Institute.

statement: Can I place inpatient neurology orders during rounding?
acceptance: Yes, according to this synthetic hospital configuration.

statement: Is EEG available on Friday?
acceptance: The guide only lists Tue/Thu; Friday availability is not provided. Do not assume.

statement: Does the hospital have CT perfusion?
acceptance: No.

statement: What is the LVO pathway after 1900 on a weekday?
acceptance: The staffed thrombectomy window has ended; ED provider initiates transfer.

statement: Which order set should I use?
acceptance: Not applicable; the teleneurologist does not enter orders.

statement: Patient has an LVO. What do I do?
acceptance: Pathway depends on staffed neurointerventional coverage, but the guide does not give coverage hours. State both branches and say coverage hours are not in the guide. Do not borrow hours from another hospital.

statement: Patient has an LVO. Do I activate the EVT team?
acceptance: No. Coverage is Mon-Fri only. ED provider initiates transfer to a regional comprehensive stroke center.

statement: Can I sign off now?
acceptance: Not until the tele-neurology encounter charge is entered.

statement: Can I change the antiplatelet during rounding?
acceptance: Medication changes require hospitalist co-sign.

statement: Where do I do the video eval for a stroke alert?
acceptance: On-call guide: CT holding bay for stroke alerts. Storyboard: patient room. Show both with sources; do not silently pick one.

statement: Is EEG available on Thursday?
acceptance: Guide lists Tue/Thu 0800-1500, so yes, but this field was last verified 2025-06-10. Flag it as possibly out of date.

statement: Who covers pediatric neurology?
acceptance: Not available in this hospital's guide. Do not use another hospital's answer.

statement: Which thrombolytic order set do I search for?
acceptance: Search "Stroke TeleCare" - "Suncrest Acute Stroke - TNK [SYN-55190]".

statement: Can I get CT perfusion on Saturday?
acceptance: No. CT perfusion is Mon-Fri 0700-1900 only.

statement: Is the rounding window open? (Provider is in Eastern time.)
acceptance: Not yet. Window is 0830-1200 Mountain; it opens in 15 minutes (10:30 ET).

statement: Who mixes the TNK?
acceptance: Guide says pharmacist during staffed hours, nursing overnight, but staffed pharmacy hours are not defined. Field last verified 2025-08-15, so also flag it as stale. Say what is unknown; do not guess the cutoff.

statement: What should I title the note?
acceptance: Neurology Consult - Remote.

statement: What note title is required?
acceptance: Not available in this hospital's guide.
